title: Stop Library page search bar from floating on scroll

requirements.text: Update the Library page search bar container so it no longer uses fixed/sticky positioning and therefore does not follow the scroll or overlap content. Specifically, change the search bar wrapper in `frontend/src/pages/LibraryPage.tsx` from `className="sticky ..."` to a non-sticky layout (`relative` or default/static flow), and remove the inline `style={{ top: 'var(--header-offset)' }}` that is only needed for sticky positioning.

quotes: The search bar on my page is currently sticking to the top and following the scroll (floating), which is overlapping with the content. Please provide a CSS snippet to change its position from fixed or sticky to absolute or relative. Also, ensure that the z-index or top properties are adjusted so it stays at the very top of the page and doesn't move when I scroll down.

acceptanceCriteria: On the Library page, the search bar remains in the normal document flow and does not move when scrolling the page content.
The search bar does not overlap subsequent content; content starts below it as expected.
No sticky/fixed behavior remains for the Library page search bar (no `position: sticky/fixed` styling and no `top: var(--header-offset)` dependency).

requirements.text: Add a reusable CSS snippet (in `frontend/src/index.css`) that developers can apply to page-level search bars to ensure non-floating behavior, using `position: relative` (or static), `top: 0`, and an appropriate `z-index` that does not overlay content unexpectedly. Ensure the Library page search bar uses this class (or an equivalent Tailwind class set) so the positioning intent is explicit.

quotes: Please provide a CSS snippet to change its position from fixed or sticky to absolute or relative. Also, ensure that the z-index or top properties are adjusted so it stays at the very top of the page and doesn't move when I scroll down.

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/index.css` contains a clearly named class (or documented snippet) for a non-sticky page search bar (relative/static positioning, `top: 0`, and a non-problematic `z-index`).
The Library page search bar styling is updated to use the new class/snippet or an equivalent Tailwind class combination, and the search bar no longer floats on scroll.

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only UI components).
Do not modify immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)`).
nonGoals: Do not change the global app header behavior in `frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout.tsx` (it may remain sticky).
Do not change search/filter logic or backend APIs; this is a styling/positioning fix only.
